SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK EVIDENCE - NOT A REAL CONTRACT - VWPB-R606-7C41-01

MASTER SAAS AGREEMENT (EXCERPT)

COVER PAGE

The attached documents describe the relationship between Rivermark Education
Systems, Inc. ("Rivermark") and the customer identified below ("Customer")
(each of Rivermark and Customer, a "Party"). The documents attached to this
Cover Page consist of the document entitled "Terms and Conditions" (the
"Access Terms") and any Order Forms for services, which describe and set
forth the general legal terms governing the relationship between the Parties
(collectively, the "Agreement"). This Agreement, including the attached
Access Terms, will become effective when this cover page is executed by
authorized representatives of both Parties (the "Effective Date").

CUSTOMER INFORMATION:
Name/Customer:  Sagebrook Education, Inc.
Address:        4200 Copper Ridge Parkway, Suite 300, Boulder, CO 80301
Billing:        Accounts Payable, ap@sagebrook-edu.example

Executed by authorized representatives of the Parties:
Rivermark Education Systems, Inc.   Date: December 15, 2025
Sagebrook Education, Inc.           Date: December 15, 2025

TERMS AND CONDITIONS (SELECTED SECTIONS)

2. ACCESS AND USE OF THE SERVICES.

2.1 Orders. Customer may order subscription services and professional
    services by executing one or more order forms referencing this Agreement
    (each, an "Order Form"). Each Order Form identifies the services
    ordered, the applicable fees, and the period of performance.

2.2 Provision of Access. Rivermark will make the hosted service available to
    Customer during each subscription period set forth on an Order Form. The
    hosted service is a standard, multi-tenant offering made available to
    all subscribing customers and is not materially modified or customized
    for Customer.

3. PROFESSIONAL SERVICES.

3.1 Implementation Services. Implementation services consist of initial
    configuration of the hosted service, migration of Customer's historical
    data, and administrator training. Implementation services are performed
    once, are expected to be completed within ninety (90) days of the first
    subscription start date, and conclude upon Customer's written acceptance.

3.2 Alternative Providers. Rivermark publishes administrator documentation
    and maintains a directory of certified third-party implementation
    consultants. Customer may elect to perform implementation itself or to
    engage a certified consultant in lieu of purchasing implementation
    services from Rivermark.

4. FEES AND PAYMENT.

4.1 Fees. In consideration for the access rights granted to Customer and the
    services performed by Rivermark under this Agreement, Customer will pay
    to Rivermark, without offset or deduction, all fees required by the
    applicable Order Form. All fees will be billed and paid in U.S. dollars
    in accordance with the timing set forth in the Order Form or, if not
    expressly set forth therein, within thirty (30) days following receipt
    of the applicable invoice. All late payments of undisputed fees will
    accrue interest at the rate of two percent (2%) per month. Except as
    provided in Section 9, all fees paid by Customer to Rivermark pursuant
    to this Agreement and any Order Form are non-refundable.

4.2 Disputed Fees. If Customer disputes any fees billed by Rivermark,
    Customer shall notify Rivermark in writing of the disputed amount within
    thirty (30) days of the invoice date, together with any relevant
    supporting information.

9. TERM AND TERMINATION.

9.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence upon the Effective Date
    and, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Section 9, shall
    continue in full force and effect until expiration of the latest period
    set forth on an Order Form (the "Term").

9.2 Elective Termination by Customer. Customer may, at its option, terminate
    this Agreement and any Order Form effective on any date on or after the
    first anniversary of the first subscription start date, upon not less
    than sixty (60) days' prior written notice to Rivermark and payment of
    an administrative termination fee of ten thousand dollars ($10,000).
    Upon such termination, Rivermark shall refund any prepaid subscription
    fees attributable to whole months following the effective date of
    termination.

9.3 Termination for Breach. Either Party may, at its option, terminate this
    Agreement in the event of a material breach by the other Party. Such
    termination may be effected only through a written notice to the
    breaching Party, specifically identifying the breach or breaches on
    which such notice of termination is based. The breaching Party will have
    a right to cure such breach or breaches within thirty (30) days of
    receipt of such notice, and this Agreement will terminate in the event
    that such cure is not made within such thirty (30)-day period.

9.4 Effect of Termination. Upon any termination, Customer's access to the
    hosted service ceases as of the effective date of termination and any
    fees then owed for services delivered remain payable.
